_comment: atelier mcp server templates. paths/URLs reflect popular community or official servers as of late 2025. update to whichever variant your team uses. these are starting points, not endorsements. fill in tokens via env or your harness's secret store before using.

figma-remote._comment: official figma mcp via remote URL (claude.ai connector style). check current docs at figma.com.

figma-dev-mode._comment: community Dev Mode MCP server. install: npm i -g figma-developer-mcp

linear-remote._comment: linear's hosted mcp endpoint. check current docs at linear.app/docs.

filesystem._comment: official filesystem mcp - sandboxed read/write within your project root. useful for skill self-inspection.

electron-mcp-server._comment: Electron app automation/debugging/testing via Chrome DevTools Protocol. github.com/halilural/electron-mcp-server, npm: electron-mcp-server. Launch/close Electron apps, take screenshots, read main/renderer/console logs, and drive UI interactions (click_by_text, fill_input, get_page_structure, eval, etc.) through send_command_to_electron — lets the agent run and visually verify this app's own Electron windows during development. Target app needs remote debugging enabled (--remote-debugging-port=9222, or pass devMode:true to the launch_electron_app tool, which sets this itself); the server auto-scans ports 9222-9225 for a running instance. SECURITY_LEVEL is hardcoded to 'balanced' (safe UI interactions allowed, eval/assignments blocked) — verified against the README's documented security levels (strict/balanced/permissive/development); override in this entry's env if you need a different level. Optional: SCREENSHOT_ENCRYPTION_KEY (32-byte hex) encrypts screenshot payloads — intentionally omitted here (zero required env) so the server works with no manual setup; add it via the Settings MCP credentials field if you want encrypted screenshots.
